dacon_rules.observed: Publicly accessible resources allowing at least noncommercial use are eligible only while their licenses and terms are respected. Three submissions/day. No hidden-evaluation training, tuning, or pseudo-labeling. Predictions must be independent across files; within-file segment aggregation is allowed.

dacon_transfer.observed: Official answer: restrictions on third-party provision make a dataset ineligible. Actual training files are required; URLs/scripts/checksums cannot replace them. Augmentation intermediates may be reconstructed from originals, code, settings and seeds. Upstream pretraining corpora need not be submitted.

dacon_labels.observed: Vocals are voice; instrumental backing is music. Components have independent authenticity labels. Any fake component makes the file fake. Non-generative enhancement of real sources remains real. Evaluation: 1,200 files, 4–60 seconds, 16 kHz; 60-minute inference, 10 GB archive, L4 22.4 GiB.

dacon_ncsa.observed: Official answer allows CC BY-NC-SA resources conditionally on public accessibility, minimum noncommercial permission, and compliance with the license.

dacon_schedule.observed: Explicit leaderboard deadline is 2026-09-29 10:00, one day before competition end. Page does not explicitly specify timezone. Its competition-period sentence still has a 2025 end-year typo; explicit deadline and end items say 2026.

jamendo.observed: 320 kbps MP3 full-track release. Audio uses per-track Creative Commons terms listed in audio_licenses.txt; metadata CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; code Apache 2.0. README additionally describes the dataset as solely noncommercial research/academic use and requires authorization for other uses.

fma.observed: Metadata CC BY 4.0 and code MIT do not license the recordings: audio remains under artist-selected licenses. Published standard dataset lists 106,574 tracks; this is not the same inventory as the recovered finding's 109,727-row raw metadata snapshot.

musdb.observed: 150 songs, 22.7 GB archive. Overall educational/noncommercial wording. 100 tracks derive from DSD100/Mixing Secrets; 46 MedleyDB CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; two Easton Ellises CC BY-NC-SA 3.0; two Native Instruments tracks. No blanket CC license covers all recordings.

arena.observed: Official public text-to-music preference/battle dataset; CC BY 4.0 label. Missing audio for some models is explicitly documented. is_instrumental describes prompt interpretation, not verified sound content; lyrics are prompt-derived.

arena_api.observed: Read-only metadata API on 2026-09-24: gated=false; lastModified=2026-08-09T19:08:41Z; revision=4dbe538410a1c14eb65270839c6fcd150c65c9fe; exactly 13,090 repository paths begin audio_files/. No audio payload was downloaded.

ace_step.observed: Model card declares MIT, permits commercial generated music, and advertises cover/repaint/vocal-to-BGM and 50+ languages. A100 speed is an author benchmark, not this project's measured throughput.

ace_step_repo.observed: README advertises Vocal2BGM accompaniment generation and local repainting; this does not establish sample-exact preservation of the supplied vocal or guarantee generated content obeys requested presence labels.

ctr_repo.observed: Author README explicitly calls the TRAIN/DEV DATA BY-NC-ND 4.0. Some bona-fide entries are not in the archives because their source licenses are more restrictive; Oniku, Ofuton, Kiritan and JVS-MuSiC require separate acquisition. Utility-code license is distinct.

ctr_zenodo.observed: Read-only API returned metadata license cc-by-4.0, train_set.zip 7,910,658,841 B and dev_set.zip 3,389,073,344 B. This conflicts with the author dataset README and is not a resolved permission grant.

ace_kising.observed: Public card: CC BY-NC 4.0, Chinese/English. Raw README reports train 24,362, validation 50, test 4,548 and download_size 10,783,178,516 B. Segment durations vary and many are under four seconds.

ace_kising_paper.observed: Author paper introduces ACE-KiSing/ACE-Opencpop as singing synthesis data built using ACE Studio; availability does not make it representative of Korean or modern jointly generated songs.

gts.observed: Official card links Google Drive, processed language metadata and paired speech; use is subject to dataset_license.md. Full Korean audio accessibility/completeness was not tested.

gts_license.observed: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 plus an additional agreement containing indemnification referring to M4Singer and representation of employer authorization. The wording was observed, not legally cleared.

seed.observed: Hugging Face license tag GPL-3.0; card body is empty.

seed_repo.observed: Official repository GPL-3.0; distinguishes a 44.1 kHz SVC checkpoint from speech VC; recommends f0_condition=True for SVC, with 30–50 diffusion steps. Model/code licensing does not itself clear source/reference recording or performer rights.

emilia.observed: Access requires contact-information sharing and agreement. Emilia is CC BY-NC 4.0; Emilia-YODAS is CC BY 4.0. Colleague access is conditioned on their agreement to the same terms. Card disclaims ownership of original audio, and reports 0.2k h Korean Emilia plus 7.3k h Korean Emilia-YODAS.

yodas.observed: CC BY 3.0 card, long-form video-level 24 kHz audio. video_id is an internal identifier, not the YouTube ID. Public contents are not proof that every recording contains genuine human speech.

cosy.observed: Apache 2.0 model card; Korean explicitly included among nine supported languages.

maskgct.observed: Model card CC BY-NC 4.0; several codec/T2S/S2A components must be accounted for. No project throughput or long-Korean output quality was measured.

melo.observed: MIT model/library card and Korean support; CPU real-time is an author claim, not a measured runtime here.

aihub.observed: AI-Hub open-data policy prohibits making data available to unapproved third parties and requires separate agreement for overseas export. Other hosted institutions have their own terms. Exclusion without specific permission is justified; a universal claim that permission can never be obtained is not.

clova.observed: Data license limits use to noncommercial AI research/development, prohibits modification/editing/reproduction and third-party provision. Its permissive CODE license does not license the audio.

eleven.observed: Restrictions 4(k)/(l) prohibit services/output as input for ML/AI training and as dataset material for training, fine-tuning, developing, testing or improving ML/AI. Restrictions apply more broadly than competing generators.

suno.observed: Effective September 3, 2026 terms: prohibited-use item 10 covers using service/output/Voice Models to power, enable or train other AI/ML tools, as well as competing products. Paid-tier output assignment remains subject to terms.

deepfake_eval.observed: CC BY-SA 4.0 card plus gated access terms explicitly permit evaluation only and prohibit training. A license tag alone misses this restriction.

anti.observed: Weights CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for research/education. 16 kHz arbitrary-length input; waveform normalization; average pooling plus linear two-class head; index order fake then real. Native example depends on fairseq. FLEURS and restored FLEURS-R/LibriTTS-R occur in training; restored variants are fake. Zero-shot card EER: ITW 1.35%, DE2024 26.76%.

anti_paper.observed: Table III's 11.86% at 4 s and 8.28% at 50 s are after DE2024-specific fine-tuning, measured over segments, not evidence for the downloadable zero-shot checkpoint on DACON. Training used up to 13 s; authors segment long recordings for memory.

hybrid.observed: Hybrid-stem study: real-vocal/AI-accompaniment FPR 94.7% with naive separated-stem detection vs 26.2% with its learned local-mixture/SNR method at the specified 0 dB condition. Authors note possible optimistic Demucs estimates from MUSDB18-HQ training overlap.

compspoof.observed: Eval ALL file-level F1: baseline .827, separation .668, separation+joint-learning .908. These are five-class speech/environment results under the paper protocol, not direct gains on DACON component EER or music hybrids.

clam.observed: CLAM encodes the same full mixed track with MERT and Wav2Vec2. MoM F1: MERT .853, Wav2Vec2 .846, dual stream without alignment .875, full triplet model .925. Learned layers/cross-aggregation and contrastive training contribute; cached stem concatenation is not the evaluated system.

atadd.observed: Track-2 winner uses audio-type routing and separate SSL experts; runner-up orange9 95.58% Macro-F1 uses EAT/XLSR fusion, augmentation and pooling. Task is a clip-level binary decision, unlike DACON's separate component labels.

atadd_fusion.observed: Runner-up combines EAT-large and XLS-R-300M with layer/token fusion and attentive statistics pooling, without requiring frame alignment; 95.58% Macro-F1 is the AT-ADD result, not a DACON expectation.
